description: UK limited company director: an employer pension contribution against taking the same profit as a dividend and paying it into a personal pension (2026/27). Corporation Tax 19% to £50,000, 25% over £250,000, marginal relief between (standard fraction 3/200, HMRC CTM03925, so 26.5% at the margin); employer contributions are deductible when wholly and exclusively for the trade, have no National Insurance and are not limited by salary (annual allowance applies); dividends: £500 allowance then 10.75% / 35.75% / 39.35%. Use this when a director asks whether to pay their pension through the company or take dividends.
